task_description: Build the human governance / multi-user admin layer AmazAI is missing: a Directory of human principals, human roles (Owner/Admin/Security/Billing/Member/Read-only Auditor) as (subject, role, scope) with a scope hierarchy sized for future workspaces, RBAC enforced server-side at the existing enforcement-in-code chokepoint, pull-based offboarding (a suspended human's next action fails closed), an org-wide kill switch, and a versioned admin audit log threaded by a correlation id — distinct from but joinable to the existing per-run bot evidence. Reuses the platform's existing policy/enforcement chokepoint, per-agent isolation, approvals/evidence, and the ownerId-on-every-row multi-user seam documented in docs/architecture/03-data-model.md rather than rebuilding them. Delivers the smallest real mergeable backend slice first (blueprint §5 MVP: roles + invite/offboard + org policy/kill switch + admin audit). Web admin surface (separate origin/route, no bot chat composer) and v1.5 items (workspaces, network allowlist, SIEM export, chargeback) are deliberate follow-up slices.

verification.review: APPROVED (v2, 2026-09-21-054129-review.md) after one NEEDS_CHANGES round (v1, 2026-09-21-052255-review.md) whose 6 in-scope issues were all addressed; a v2 non-blocking follow-up (kill-switch freeze write ordering) was then also fixed.
verification.summary: Final pass after the semantic-review loop (v1 NEEDS_CHANGES -> fixes -> v2 APPROVED) plus a small approved follow-up. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -> 989 passed, 3 failed. The 3 failures are the documented PRE-EXISTING tests/test_gaps_api.py toolchain-drift failures (a bare Store('owner-a') not bound to the moto table under boto3 1.43/moto 5.2.3), unchanged from the 730/3 clean-main baseline and unrelated to this task. cd infra && npx cdk synth -> exit 0. cd web && npm run build -> exit 0, dist/index.html present. No Dockerfile drives this backend feature, so docker_build is skipped. Test quality: the suites are behavioural, not static — RBAC negative tests assert the gate fires BEFORE any state change (no audit row written); the actor-from-token test proves the {subject} path segment is the target not the actor; the suspended-human test mutates state in place and proves the next call fails closed (pull-based); TestFreezingFailsBotActionsClosed includes an explicit guard-reversion proof (test_reverting_the_guard_would_let_the_run_proceed) pinning govern.assert_not_frozen; TestAuditIsWrittenFirst and TestFreezeFailsClosedOnTheAction crash the second write and prove the fail-closed direction; the single-tenant seam is proven by authenticating AS the invited subject. All would fail if the enforcement were reverted. 4 clean source-only commits sit ahead of origin/main (452bdec, 27ee155, 1d22d43, 1197ed6); the working tree is clean apart from the untracked .agents/ plan directory. NOTE: the repo tracks some __pycache__/*.pyc files that pytest dirties; those were kept out of every commit and reverted from the working tree.
deferred_followups: Multi-tenant reality: the Directory is honestly single-tenant in this slice (Store stamps/filters ownerId==caller-sub and org_id==user_id today, so an invited human's seat is written under the inviter's org and is not readable by the invitee's own Store). load_membership documents this and tests enforce the boundary. Before real human teams, org-scoped rows must be owned by orgId with a subject->org lookup (docs/architecture/03-data-model.md multi-user seam).

Blueprint MVP items intentionally not built this slice (deliberate follow-up surface; capabilities/audit actions for several already exist): org ask-first policies + approval queue, usage/hard-budget-cap admin routes (SEE_ALL_USAGE/MANAGE_PAYMENT), impersonation break-glass route (IMPERSONATE + impersonation.started/ended audit actions), connector-revoke-by-admin route.
Web admin surface: a separate-origin/route admin console with NO bot chat composer (blueprint IA) is not part of this backend slice.

v1.5+ blueprint scope: workspaces/hard isolation (the (subject, role, scope, scope_id) tuple is already modelled for this), network allowlists, SIEM/OTel export (the admin-audit envelope is already versioned for it), routine governance, chargeback tags, secret scanning.
